# AFA hearing Website - Project Instructions

This is a Next.js website for AFA hearing, a hearing aid clinic in Melbourne, Victoria.

## Project Overview
- **Framework**: Next.js 14+ with TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Color Scheme**: Green (health/trust) and Orange (warm/energy)
- **Features**: Appointment booking, services, about, contact/map, testimonials, product catalog

## Key Requirements
- Modern, vibrant design similar to professional hearing clinic websites (e.g., Amplifon)
- Fully responsive mobile-first design
- Professional clinic branding
- Appointment scheduling system
- Contact and location integration

## Development
Run `npm run dev` to start the development server.
Build with `npm run build` for production.
